claim_being_audited: That certifying the model is policy-compliant because aggregate performance clears the deployment threshold, provided the certification explicitly discloses the unresolved small-business support slice weakness, notes no approved mitigation currently removes exposure, and treats the slice as a follow-up confirmation issue rather than a clean pass.
specific_concerns: The auditor has only the actor's summary and evidence IDs, not the underlying admissible contents of those records.
The exact quantitative claims about aggregate performance and subgroup underperformance are not independently verifiable from the available evidence summary alone.
The packet asserts that disclosure is required because the subgroup weakness is material, but the underlying materiality basis is not directly shown.
The claim that no approved mitigation removes exposure depends on approval-status evidence that is not visible in the current record.
The recommended action is supportable only if the final certification actually contains the stated disclosure; that final disclosure text is not provided.
unsupported_claims: The model exceeds the aggregate deployment threshold by 2.2 percentage points.
The small-business support slice is 1.1 percentage points below its warning threshold and 2.6 points below its preferred threshold.
The only mitigation in the record is an unapproved draft and therefore no approved mitigation removes exposure.
The small-business slice has higher uncertainty due to smaller sample size, as characterized in the packet.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying contents or excerpts for BMCARD-022-A through BMCARD-022-E showing the aggregate threshold, observed aggregate result, subgroup thresholds, subgroup result, and confidence interval/sample size.
Provide the policy excerpt or model-card rule text establishing that subgroup weaknesses must be disclosed unless an approved mitigation removes exposure.
Provide the approval-status record for the cited mitigation showing whether it is draft, reviewed, approved, or rejected.
Provide the proposed certification disclosure text or final model-card language that will accompany certification.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates may support launch readiness but do not erase subgroup weaknesses.
Small-sample uncertainty may justify follow-up monitoring but does not convert an unresolved subgroup weakness into a clean certification.
Quantitative and approval-status claims should be traceable to admissible evidence, not only to the actor's characterization.
